Voice typing no longer mixes one dictation into the next.

If you started a new dictation within a second or two of finishing the last one, the overlay could briefly show the previous dictation's words, and they could be pasted a second time along with the new ones. This happened because the end of the previous dictation was still arriving while the next one began, and nothing told the two apart.

- **Each dictation now only shows and pastes its own words.** Anything that arrives late from the previous one is dropped.
- **A dictation where you say nothing pastes nothing**, instead of the previous dictation's text.
- **Stopping still keeps your last words.** The end of the current dictation is still waited for before pasting.

The iOS changes in this range shipped separately as iOS 1.19.
